mapper.select: SELECT plan_id, user_idx, title, destination, start_date, end_date, is_public, share_token, plan_source, created_at, updated_at FROM TRAVEL_PLAN WHERE user_idx = #{user_idx} ORDER BY plan_id DESC
select plan_id, user_idx, title, destination, start_date, end_date, is_public, share_token, plan_source, created_at, updated_at from TRAVEL_PLAN where plan_id = #{plan_id} and user_idx = #{user_idx}

SELECT plan_spot_id, plan_id, spot_id, place_name, visit_date, visit_order, created_at FROM PLAN_SPOT WHERE plan_id = #{value} ORDER BY CASE WHEN visit_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, visit_date ASC, visit_order ASC
SELECT spot_idx, spot_id, name, region, address, latitude, longitude, description, rating_avg, review_count FROM SPOT_TRAVEL ORDER BY name ASC
mapper.insert: insert into TRAVEL_PLAN ( user_idx, title, destination, start_date, end_date, is_public, share_token, plan_source, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{user_idx}, #{title}, #{destination}, #{start_date}, #{end_date}, #{is_public}, #{share_token}, #{plan_source}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE TRAVEL_PLAN SET title = #{title}, destination = #{destination}, start_date = #{start_date}, end_date = #{end_date}, is_public = #{is_public}, plan_source = #{plan_source}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE plan_id = #{plan_id} AND user_idx = #{user_idx}
mapper.delete: delete from TRAVEL_PLAN where plan_id = #{plan_id} and user_idx = #{user_idx}
